{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2bbe867a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Fill the hollow panels on the left with the matching colored motif on the right."""
    h = len(grid)
    if not h or not grid[0]:
        return []
    base = grid[0][0]
    w = len(grid[0])

    # The left panel width is the initial run of the frame color in the top bar.
    panel_w = 0
    while panel_w < w and grid[0][panel_w] == base:
        panel_w += 1

    # Locate the full-width horizontal frame bars.
    bars = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == base for c in range(panel_w))]
    if len(bars) < 2:
        return [row[:panel_w] for row in grid]

    # Encode each right-hand colored motif by its exact translated cell pattern.
    motifs = {}
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, base)}:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
        c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
        motifs[color] = frozenset((r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells)

    out = [row[:panel_w] for row in grid[:bars[-1] + 1]]
    for top, bottom in zip(bars, bars[1:]):
        holes = [(r, c) for r in range(top + 1, bottom)
                 for c in range(panel_w) if grid[r][c] != base]
        if not holes:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, _ in holes)
        r1 = max(r for r, _ in holes)
        c0 = min(c for _, c in holes)
        c1 = max(c for _, c in holes)
        signature = frozenset((r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in holes)
        color = next((k for k, shape in motifs.items() if shape == signature), None)
        if color is None:
            raise ValueError(f"No matching motif for panel {top}:{bottom}")
        for r, c in holes:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
"
}
